risk_description: Stale localhost WinINET proxy blocks browser and SSO flows while ping may still succeed.
recommended_action: Preview proxy-disable with typed confirmation and rollback snapshot
business_explanation: Users cannot reach SaaS and SSO sites; helpdesk volume rises while root cause appears as network outage.

risk_description: Unattributed localhost proxy listener increases triage uncertainty and delays safe remediation.
recommended_action: Collect Sysmon E13 or Procmon evidence before process action
business_explanation: Without writer attribution, operations may reset network stacks blindly, increasing repeat incidents.

risk_description: TLS path contrast suggests investigation context; not confirmed interception.
recommended_action: Route to cyber risk triage with limitations; do not label as confirmed MITM
business_explanation: Certificate path anomalies can affect regulated workflows and customer trust if miscommunicated.
